name: Marcus Irvin
statement:
Iowa Artist Marcuso Irvin is local and intrinsic to Cedar Rapids.   I create large scale paintings and murals that I would describe as Expressionistic Surrealism sometimes with a twist of tongue-in-cheek,  My goal is to bring vibrant visual arts to the local community of Cedar Rapids, and create work that translates to the public as more than just a beautiful or pretty painting.  Art where people connect to it on levels deeper than what they see on the surface.
My work is bold and balanced with color, technical, but blended with integrated abstract features.  Once you see the painting in person you can feel the impact of the images and allow your imagination to run free.
I take subjects from real life and create an image that crosses the boundaries of senses and emotions that people identify with.  One field where the light comes from the depth within the piece.  Fluid in nature where there viewer interprets their own expression.  My goal is for my art to be seen and engaged by my local community.
